title: When Steering Shifts Discourse: Identifying and Intervening on Discourse-Level Changes due to Activation Steering in LLMs
summary: Controlled tests find unintended discourse changes under activation steering and report partial reversal by complementary steering vectors while preserving intended behavior; scope is the tested models, dimensions and datasets.
ai_technology: Activation steering adds vectors to LLM residual-stream activations; human annotations and an LLM judge measure discourse changes and reversal.
